name: Horny Hell - Vacation
source:
Side story to Horny Hell webcomic created for Yaoi Game Jam 2021

Leonard and Camio go on a long deserved vacation

Play as either of them in this short visual novel to find out how they spend their time out of Hell

[from [url=https://animefanka.itch.io/horny-hell-vacation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为Yaoi Game Jam 2021创建的《欲火地狱》网络漫画的支线故事

伦纳德和卡米奥度过了一个应得的漫长假期

在这部短篇视觉小说中扮演他们中的任何一个，看看他们如何度过摆脱地狱的时光

[来自[url=https://animefanka.itch.io/horny-hell-vacation]Itch.io[/url]]
